resumo: Grass, sand, gravel, dry leaves. Walking on different surfaces is fun and practice at the same time, and the park down the road will do.

secoes.texto: A child learning to walk spends most of the time on the same smooth floor at home. Every different surface is a new problem for the body to solve, and it is also an outing that costs nothing: it already exists a few blocks from you.

itens: Grass, which gives a little and changes the balance.
Dry sand and wet sand, which are two completely different things.
Gravel in a square, with you holding a hand.
The wooden boards of a deck, with the gaps between them.
A shallow puddle, in wellies, the day after the rain.
A gentle slope, up and down, which is another exercise altogether.

secoes.texto: Clothes that can get dirty without it becoming a problem, a full change, water and as little else as possible. An outing with a lot of luggage tires whoever carries it and cuts the trip short.

A photo of her feet on the surface of the day, always from the same angle, from above. Over a year it becomes a wonderful series, and it is the easiest photo to take of a child who never stands still.
